use_cases: Expandable FAQ sections for product documentation and help centers
Collapsible content panels for organizing dense information on landing pages
Navigation menus with nested categories that expand on demand
Step-by-step wizards with collapsible individual steps
Feature comparison tables where details expand inline
ai_summary: A motion-primitives accordion component using Framer Motion for smooth expand/collapse animations. Built with a provider pattern for state management and supports controlled/uncontrolled modes with customizable animation variants. Features a clean, accessible structure with context-based communication between accordion items.
